title: meibomia paniculata var. obtusa
intro: Meibomia paniculata var. obtusa, commonly known as Butterfly Weed, is a plant species in the milkweed family. This plant is known for its bright orange flowers and is often used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Butterfly Weed include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Butterfly Weed include cardenolides, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
